items.exampleEn: The school cafeteria serves chocolate pudding every Friday.
items.exampleZh: 學校餐廳每週五都供應巧克力布丁。

items.exampleEn: The salsa at this restaurant is too spicy for my kids.
items.exampleZh: 這家餐廳的莎莎醬太辣了，我的孩子吃不了。

items.exampleEn: The starving kittens followed us all the way home.
items.exampleZh: 那幾隻餓壞的小貓一路跟著我們回家。

items.exampleEn: The hotel leaves a small mint on every pillow.
items.exampleZh: 那家飯店在每個枕頭上放一顆小薄荷糖。

items.exampleEn: Farmers in this area grow soybeans and corn.
items.exampleZh: 這個地區的農民種植黃豆和玉米。

items.exampleEn: Most of the world's cocoa is grown in hot, wet countries.
items.exampleZh: 世界上大部分的可可都種在炎熱潮濕的國家。

items.exampleEn: This mango is so ripe that the juice runs down your hand.
items.exampleZh: 這顆芒果熟到汁會沿著手往下流。

items.sentenceEn: In many countries, soybeans are used to make milk and sauce.
items.sentenceZh: 在許多國家，黃豆被用來做豆漿和醬料。

items.audioEn: I'm starving! Is there anything to eat before dinner is ready?
items.audioZh: 我餓壞了！晚餐好之前有什麼可以吃的嗎？
options: A short rest on the sofa

items.sentenceEn: A cup of hot cocoa is perfect on a snowy evening.
items.sentenceZh: 下雪的夜晚，來一杯熱可可再適合不過了。

items.sentenceEn: We ate fresh mangoes every day during our trip to the south.
items.sentenceZh: 我們去南部旅行時，每天都吃新鮮芒果。

items.stemEn: She added fresh ____ leaves to the lemon water to make it taste cool.
items.stemZh: 她在檸檬水裡加了新鮮薄荷葉，讓味道更清涼。

items.stemEn: After hiking for six hours without lunch, we were all ____.
items.stemZh: 健行了六個小時都沒吃午餐，我們全都餓壞了。

items.passageEn: Our class held an international food day last Friday. Each group cooked a dish from a different country. My group made a dish from Mexico with fresh tomato salsa. Another group brought sweet mango with sticky rice, and a third made a dessert of soybean milk and fruit. The teacher prepared cold cocoa for everyone. By noon, we were starving, and the room smelled wonderful. The most popular dish was a rich bread pudding, served in a big pot with a glass lid. To finish, we all had cold tea with mint, which was perfect on such a warm day.
items.passageZh: 我們班上週五舉辦了國際美食日。每組做一道來自不同國家的料理。我們這組做了一道墨西哥菜，配上新鮮的番茄莎莎醬。另一組帶來甜芒果配糯米飯，第三組則用豆漿和水果做了一道甜點。老師幫大家準備了冰可可。到了中午，我們都餓壞了，教室裡香氣四溢。最受歡迎的是一道香濃的麵包布丁，裝在一個有玻璃蓋的大鍋裡。最後，我們喝了加薄荷的冰茶，在這麼溫暖的日子再適合不過了。

questions.questionZh: 作者那組做了什麼料理？
最受歡迎的料理是什麼？

items.promptZh: 我想在烤魚上加點莎莎醬。
referenceEn: I'd like to add some salsa to my grilled fish.
I want to put some salsa on my grilled fish.
rubricZh: salsa 是不可數名詞（例如 some salsa）
「想」可寫 I'd like to、I want to 等；「烤魚」可寫 grilled fish 等

items.promptZh: 這個布丁需要放在冰箱裡冷藏兩個小時。
referenceEn: This pudding needs to stay in the fridge for two hours.
You need to keep this pudding in the fridge for two hours.
rubricZh: pudding 指「布丁」（例如 this pudding 等）
「需要」可寫，例如 needs to、has to、should 等
